name: Charades
description: Act it out without a word. The others guess.
howToPlay: Pass the phone to the actor. Only they see the word.
Act it out without speaking while the others shout guesses.
Get as many as you can in 60 seconds. Hard words score 2. Skip if it’s too hard.

nb.name: Mimeleken
nb.description: Mim det uten ord. De andre gjetter.
howToPlay: Gi telefonen til den som skal mime. Bare de ser ordet.
Mim uten å snakke mens de andre roper ut gjetninger.
Få så mange du kan på 60 sekunder. Vanskelige ord gir 2 poeng. Hopp over hvis det er for vanskelig.
